info.name: Atlassian Search for Code in Teams Repositories

params.name: username
params.description: The account to search in; either the username or the UUID in curly braces

params.name: page
params.description: Which page of the search results to retrieve

params.description: How many search results to retrieve per page

items.docs: This API operation allows you to search for code across all repositories belonging to a specific team in Bitbucket. By making a GET request to the endpoint with the team's username as a path parameter, you can perform code searches within the team's repository collection. items.docs: The Atlassian Bitbucket User API endpoint `/users/{selected_user}/search/code` accessed via GET method enables developers to perform code searches across all repositories belonging to a specific user. items.docs: This GET endpoint allows you to search for code across repositories within a specified Atlassian Bitbucket workspace. By providing the workspace identifier in the path parameter, you can perform code searches using query parameters to find specific strings, patterns, or code snippets across all accessible repositories in that workspace.
